description: Trigger evals for model-invoked project skills (.claude/skills/*, excluding disable-model-invocation ones: fix-issue, intent-to-spec). Each case runs in a fresh `claude -p` session; a positive passes if the skill loads, a near-miss passes if it does not. Other skills loading does not affect the score.
